reuse: The existing document reader: documents.ts enqueue() and the document-extraction job (one job authority, run by cases/processing.ts), in mode native_only so no provider is called (D4).
The batch tray item and its one transition writer writeIntakeDraftTx (intake-ledger.ts).
The pinned page viewer (CitedPageViewer through EvidenceProvider, GET /api/v1/sources/{sourceId}/pages) as the existing document review the batch item links to.
IntakeDropDialog and the uploads route for the building Add files PDFs.

changes.packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestio: queueBatchDocumentTx: a batch PDF's retained original gets its document receipt (documentOriginal, same subject, hash and bytes) and one native_only document job; a prior job is reused, never a second read.

A probed PDF starts that job instead of resting kept; on the job's completion or failure the item is written in an officer's words (pages read, pages with no text layer, passages naming floors or rooms as candidates).
Seam outside the owned paths, two calls: the accept transaction and failDocumentJob settle the batch item. No other task in the prompt owns it.
changes.apps/studio/src/features/intake/BatchPag: EvidenceProvider around the tray so a read PDF opens in the page viewer.
changes.apps/studio/src/features/intake/IntakeTr: Seam outside the owned paths: a Review pages step for a read PDF, pinned to the source revision and hash from the case detail.
changes.apps/studio/src/features/intake/batch-mo: Seam outside the owned paths: a document item reading says pages, not records.
changes.apps/studio/src/features/intake/AddFiles: D3, seam outside the owned paths: the building Add files sends PDFs to a batch through IntakeDropDialog (uploads route and server reader); other files keep their route.

needs: No runtime, Docker, GPU or provider call. Real inputs read once with the repository's own native PDF reader (pinned pypdf 5.5.0) in a scratch environment; counts only are kept.
